name: Dynamic Silence (Strategic Pausing)
scenario: Following a competitor's aggressive opening proposal in an acquisition negotiation.
script: (Maintain completely calm facial posture, sustained neutral eye contact, and deliberately hold total silence for four to eight full seconds following the counterpart's statement).
defense: Acknowledge the pause and hold: take whatever time you need; I am ready to explore the underlying economics.
originFull: Conversational Turn-Taking and Social Void Discomfort suggest that human conversational dynamics treat silence as a relational rift, creating psychological pressure that compels individuals to speak and disclose latent concessions.
defenseFull: When confronted with prolonged dynamic silence, acknowledge the pause and hold the boundary: "I recognize that proposal requires careful processing. Take whatever time you need; I am ready to explore the underlying economics whenever you are."
